named-native-query.name: EsqOrgJpa.customOrg
named-native-query.query: SELECT opr_par_name as "name" , opr_value as "value" FROM esq_org_par WHERE opr_org_pk = :id

named-native-query.name: EsqUsrJpa.customUsr
named-native-query.query: SELECT upr_par_name as "name" , upr_value as "value" FROM esq_usr_par WHERE upr_usr_pk = :id

named-native-query.name: EsqUsrJpa.updateCustomUsr
named-native-query.query: UPDATE esq_usr_par SET upr_value = :value WHERE upr_usr_pk = :id AND upr_par_name = :name

named-native-query.name: EsqOrgJpa.updateCustomOrg
named-native-query.query: UPDATE esq_org_par SET opr_value = :value WHERE opr_org_pk = :id AND opr_par_name = :name
